svg.aria-label: A product captures a feature interaction Two input features → Keep inputs, add area: Add an interaction: $x_3 = x_1 x_2$ Identity preserved: Rows A–D and both inputs stay fixed; the added column is area. Width and length $x_1$ | $x_2$ A: 1 | 1 B: 1 | 2 C: 2 | 1 D: 2 | 2 $x_1$ is width; $x_2$ is length. Area is their product. The derived product $x_1$ | $x_2$ | $x_1 x_2$ A: 1 | 1 | 1 B: 1 | 2 | 2 C: 2 | 1 | 2 D: 2 | 2 | 4 $x_1 x_2$: highlighted column When $x_1$ rises from 1 to 2, area rises by $x_2$: by 1 at $x_2=1$, by 2 at $x_2=2$. The new feature lets a model use area while keeping width and length separately.
